sentences: 26 of 30 units (87%) had at least one excursion outside <=5 C during the recording; the median unit spent 38% of the time in range.
886 excursion events were found; 7% lasted two hours or more (median 55 min, longest 7200 min).
The door position runs warmest (mean 6.9 C), 2.0 C above the veg position.
Out-of-range time peaks around 02:00 (58.9% of unit-time at the worst hour vs 55.8% on average).
Unit type 'twodoor' spent the least time in range (34% on average) vs 'sidebyside' (52%).
